title.narrative: INTEGRATED SOCIAL PROTECTION AND PROMOTION PROJECT

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to improve access of the Borrower's poor citizens to an integrated package of social protection and promotion opportunities, including in particular human capital, enhanced employability, and housing improvements in selected provinces.

The development objective for the Integrated Social Protection and Promotion Project for the Dominican Republic is to improve access of the borrower's poor citizens to an integrated package of social protection and promotion opportunities, including, in particular, human capital, enhanced employability, and housing improvements in selected provinces. The project has three components. (1) Integrated area-based social protection and pro-poor service delivery component aims to improve access of poor citizens of selected provinces to an integrated package of social protection and promotion opportunities by bridging conditional cash transfer (CCT) coverage gaps for eligible extremely poor households, increasing access of extremely poor CCT users to housing improvements, and increasing access of extremely and moderately poor CCT users to productive opportunities. (2) Strengthening of the Progresando con Solidaridad (PROSOLI) CCT Program and support to targeted households component will strengthen operational processes and its capacity to effectively link targeted households to newly available opportunities and services in selected provinces. (3) Enhancing equity and results orientation component will complement targeted interventions at the territorial level with institutional strengthening at the national policy level to sustain progress in building blocks of the social protection system. The project directly benefits a significant share of current and new PROSOLI users, who will be receiving cash transfers aiming to increase household consumption and human capital investments and to improve beneficiaries' health, nutrition, education, and productivity.

title.narrative: Employment rate of PROSOLI users (men and women) 18-29 years in selected provinces who receive vocational training, versus that of the control group.

comment.narrative: <p>According to impact evaluation results, the employment rate of PROSOLI users who received vocational education was not statistically different from the employment rate of the control group.  Although the target was not met, additional findings from the impact evaluation suggest other positive employment impacts: higher salaries and scores on hard skills tests, and more intensive job search and job readiness as preparing CVs and using job search platforms, among the treatment group.</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of eligible households whose socio-economic situation is updated by SIUBEN based on the SIUBEN III socio economic categorization.

comment.narrative: <p>SIUBEN 2 contained 1.8 million households.  The achievement of this indicator can be measured in three ways. First, SIUBEN 3 registered 2.1 million households, leading to a conclusion that information had been updated for 100 percent when compared to SIUBEN 2.  Second, more precise “matching” between databases of these two studies indicates that 1.1 million householdsin SIUBEN 2 can be matched to SIUBEN 3, a share of 61 percent.  Finally, 86 percent of current SUPERATE beneficiaries arecertified in the SIUBEN 3 database. In sum, although the definition of the indicator is open to interpretation, the target was met in all three scenarios.</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of eligible PROSOLI ICV-I and ICV 2 household members newly incorporated by the National helath Insurance Program SENASA.

comment.narrative: <p>The original coverage target translated into 229,900 ICV1 household members enrolled in SENASA.  The formally revised target was to enroll 150,000 household members (97,768 ICV1 and 52,232 ICV2).  151, 533 household members were enrolled, meeting the target.  Performance for ICV1 household members was less than targeted, but the gap was made up by better performance for ICV2 household members.</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of participants from PROSOLI households categorized as ICVI and ICV2 that finish vocational training

comment.narrative: <p>Considering youth who participated in at least one part of the training cycle (34,942), 30,756 finished the cycle, a share of 88percent, above the target of 60 percent and high by international standards, especially for the poor.  The share of 101.58 represents the number of youth who finished the training, relative to the revised target of 30,000.</p>

title.narrative: Number of Beneficiaries of vocational training package

comment.narrative: <p>The number of beneficiaries who participated in at least one part of the training cycle was 34,942, among which 30,756 finished the cycle.  Both figures exceed the target of 30,000.</p>

title.narrative: Number of Puntos Solidarios equipped and functioning in the 14 provinces

comment.narrative: <p>The target for the number of “Puntos Solidarios” equipped and functioning met the target.  The figure rises to 39 if other modalities (mobile and platforms) are also considered.</p>

title.narrative: Number of modules of the Integrated Monitoring and Evaluation System (SIME) developed and functioning

comment.narrative: <p>The four modules of the SIME were developed and functioned to prepare sectoral reports and the annual sector planning documents. The new administration has decided to revamp SIME using the platform developed by this Project. </p>

title.narrative: Number of community report card cycles implemented and supervision initiated in the 14 provinces

comment.narrative: <p>The number of community report card cycles (4) met the target.</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of vocational training participants who are women

comment.narrative: <p>The share of vocational training participants who are women was about 70 percent, amply exceeding the target of 50 percent, with a similar share for those who finished training.</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of beneficiary households whose dirt floors were replaced reporting an improvement in living conditions.

comment.narrative: <p>According to results of the impact evaluation, 80 percent of households benefiting from floor replacement report an improvement in living conditions, meeting the target.???????</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of eligible extremely poor PROSOLI users in selected provinces with dirt floors replaced by reinforced cement floors.

comment.narrative: <p>The coverage target translated to replacing floors for 7,500 ICV1 households.  Floors were replaced for 9,072 ICV1 households, equivalent to a share of 84.7 percent, amply exceeding the target.???????</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of PROSOLI field staff trained on new integrated territorial intervention strategy in selected provinces

comment.narrative: <p>1,294 PROSOLI field staff were trained under the Project, representing 86 percent of staff, meeting the target.</p>

title.narrative: Number of entities associated with the GCPS trained and applying instruments to assess performance of priority social protection programs

comment.narrative: <p>Nine entities associated with the GCPS were trained and applied instruments to assess performance of priority social protection programs during the lifetime of the project despite frequent staff turn-overs. The new administration benefitted from these reporting to inform the sector  reform.</p>
<p>The formally revised (higher) target was amply exceeded.  The share of female beneficiaries of 50.85 percent fell slightly short of the original target (and the baseline) of 52 percent.</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of household members, categorized as ICV I and ICV2 who meet eligibility criteria, identified and incorporated by PROSOLI into the ILAE program in selected provinces.

comment.narrative: <p>The original coverage target translated into 71,909 children in ICV1 households enrolled in ILAE.  The formally revised target was to enroll 129,671 children (47,214 ICV1 and 82,457 ICV2).  144,651 children were enrolled (63,304 ICV1 and 81,347 ICV2), exceeding the higher revised target by 12 percent.???????</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of extremely and moderate poor households who are incorporated in CCT PROSOLI in selected provinces

comment.narrative: <p>The original coverage target translated into 60,669 ICV1 households enrolled in CEP.  The formally revised target was to enroll 124,231 households (59,731 ICV1 and 64,500 ICV2).  140,660 households were enrolled (66,480 ICV1 and 74,180 ICV2), exceeding the higher revised target by 13 percent due to better-than-expected performance for ICV2 households.???????<em>?????</em>??????????????</p>

title.narrative: Customer Relation Management System (CRM) developed and functioning

comment.narrative: <p>The Customer Relation Management System (CRM) was developed and is functioning.</p>

title.narrative: Technological platform for information exchange between SIUBEN and other public institutions is developed and implemented

comment.narrative: <p>The technological platform for information exchange was developed and implemented.</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of household members, categorized as ICV I and ICV 2 who meet eligibility criteria, identified and incorporated into Bono Escolar Estudiando Progreso in selected provinces.

comment.narrative: <p>The original coverage target translated into 33,623 children in ICV1 households enrolled in BEEP.  The formally revised target was to enroll  63,917 children (17,434 ICV1 and 46,483 ICV2).  128,018 children were enrolled (27,614 ICV1 and 100,404 ICV2), double the higher revised target. Overachievement is explained mainly by the fact that in a restructuring of the education system in 2019, 2 grade levels were moved from basic to middle and secondary education, thereby increasing the pool of children eligible for BEEP.</p>
